senses.gloss:
शैक्ष शैक्ष, अस्, m. (fr. शिक्षा), a young
Brāhman studying with his preceptor, a youthful
student just commencing the study of the Vedas (=
प्राथमकल्पिक).

शैक्षिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to
Śikṣā or the science of euphony; (अस्), m. one
skilled in the above science.

शैक्ष्य, अम्, n. learning, skill.
—शैक्ष्य-
गुण-क्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing skill, cleverness
and dexterity.

सैकत सैकत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सिकता), sandy,
gravelly, having sandy soil; (अम्), n. a sand-bank;
an island with sandy shores; any bank or shore.
—सैकत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing sand-banks.
—सैकतेष्ट (˚त-इष्˚), अम्, n. ‘loved by sandy
soil,’ ginger.

सैकतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to
sand-banks; fluctuating, living in doubt and error,
= सन्देह-जीविन्; (अस्), m. a religious mendi-
cant; an ascetic; (अम्), n. a thread worn round the
wrist or neck to secure good fortune (= मङ्गल-
सूत्र); = मातृ-यात्रा (according to Śabda-k.).
